name: Evaluate athletic performance and historical sports records
description: Users asked to evaluate, compare, or rank individual athletes, teams, and historical sports moments based on specific performance metrics, skills, or competitive outcomes. The requests often involved detailed qualitative or quantitative assessments, such as identifying the greatest players of all time, analyzing the causes of a team's decline or relegation, or creating custom rankings based on user-defined criteria.
